title: The Nose
synopsis: Teacher Zhang has an unusual nose.

fullText.simplified:
张汉叫了几个人来，帮他打鼻子。他把鼻子放进热水里，再让那几个人打他的鼻子。他想会很疼，但是没想到，鼻子放进热水里的时候，他不觉得疼。别人打他鼻子的时候，他也不觉得疼。
    过了一会儿，他发现，他的鼻子上有一个白色的东西掉了出来，鼻子变短了一点。
    他又把鼻子放进热水里，再让那几个人打他的鼻子，还让他们多打几次。又过了一会儿，他的鼻子上又有一个白色的东西出来了。他的鼻子又变短了一点。
    他很高兴。就这样，他把鼻子放进热水里，再让人打他的鼻子，白色的东西又出来了一点。他把鼻子放热水里，再让人打他的鼻子……白色的东西一点一点地出来了，他的鼻子一点一点地变短了。不知道过了多长时间，他的鼻子真的变短了，变得和别人一样短了。
fullText.traditional:
張漢叫了幾個人來，幫他打鼻子。他把鼻子放進熱水裡，再讓那幾個人打他的鼻子。他想會很疼，但是沒想到，鼻子放進熱水裡的時候，他不覺得疼。別人打他鼻子的時候，他也不覺得疼。
    過了一會兒，他發現，他的鼻子上有一個白色的東西掉了出來，鼻子變短了一點。
    他又把鼻子放進熱水裡，再讓那幾個人打他的鼻子，還讓他們多打幾次。又過了一會兒，他的鼻子上又有一個白色的東西出來了。他的鼻子又變短了一點。
    他很高興。就這樣，他把鼻子放進熱水裡，再讓人打他的鼻子，白色的東西又出來了一點。他把鼻子放熱水裡，再讓人打他的鼻子……白色的東西一點一點地出來了，他的鼻子一點一點地變短了。不知道過了多長時間，他的鼻子真的變短了，變得和別人一樣短了。

sentences.simplified: 张汉叫了几个人来，帮他打鼻子。
sentences.traditional: 張漢叫了幾個人來，幫他打鼻子。
sentences.pinyin: zhāng hàn jiào le jǐ ge rén lái bāng tā dǎ bí zi
sentences.english: Zhang Han asked a few people to come and hit his nose for him.

sentences.simplified: 他把鼻子放进热水里，再让那几个人打他的鼻子。
sentences.traditional: 他把鼻子放進熱水裡，再讓那幾個人打他的鼻子。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ bí zi fàng jìn rè shuǐ lǐ zài ràng nà jǐ ge rén dǎ tā de bí zi
sentences.english: He put his nose into hot water, and then had these people hit his nose.

sentences.simplified: 他想会很疼，但是没想到，鼻子放进热水里的时候，他不觉得疼。
sentences.traditional: 他想會很疼，但是沒想到，鼻子放進熱水裡的時候，他不覺得疼。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng huì hěn téng dàn shì méi xiǎng dào bí zi fàng jìn rè shuǐ lǐ de shí hou tā bù jué de téng
sentences.english: He thought it would be very painful, but unexpectedly, when he put his nose in the hot water, it didn’t hurt.

sentences.simplified: 别人打他鼻子的时候，他也不觉得疼。
sentences.traditional: 別人打他鼻子的時候，他也不覺得疼。
sentences.pinyin: bié ren dǎ tā bí zi de shí hou tā yě bù jué de téng
sentences.english: When other people hit his nose, it also didn’t hurt.

sentences.simplified: 过了一会儿，他发现，他的鼻子上有一个白色的东西掉了出来，鼻子变短了一点。
sentences.traditional: 過了一會兒，他發現，他的鼻子上有一個白色的東西掉了出來，鼻子變短了一點。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì'r tā fā xiàn tā de bí zi shang yǒu yí ge bái sè de dōng xi diào le chū lái bí zi biàn duǎn le yì diǎn
sentences.english: After a while, he found that a white thing had fallen out of his nose and his nose had become a bit shorter.

sentences.traditional: 他又把鼻子放進熱水裡，
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu bǎ bí zi fàng jìn rè shuǐ lǐ
sentences.english: He put his nose in the hot water again.

sentences.simplified: 再让那几个人打他的鼻子，还让他们多打几次。

sentences.pinyin: zài ràng nà jǐ ge rén dǎ tā de bí zi hái ràng tā men duō dǎ jǐ cì
sentences.english: Then he got the people to hit his nose again, and let them hit it a few more times.

sentences.simplified: 又过了一会儿，他的鼻子上又有一个白色的东西出来了。他的鼻子又变短了一点。
sentences.traditional: 又過了一會兒，他的鼻子上又有一個白色的東西出來了。他的鼻子又變短了一點。
sentences.pinyin: yòu guò le yí huì'r tā de bí zi shang yòu yǒu yí ge bái sè de dōng xi chū lái le tā de bí zi yòu biàn duǎn le yì diǎn
sentences.english: After a while, another white thing came out of his nose. His nose became shorter again.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，他把鼻子放进热水里，再让人打他的鼻子，白色的东西又出来了一点。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，他把鼻子放進熱水裡，再讓人打他的鼻子，白色的東西又出來了一點。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng tā bǎ bí zi fàng jìn rè shuǐ lǐ zài ràng rén dǎ tā de bí zi bái sè de dōng xi yòu chū lái le yì diǎn
sentences.english: Just like this, he put his nose in hot water, then had people hit his nose, and a bit more of something white came out.

sentences.simplified: 白色的东西一点一点地出来了，他的鼻子一点一点地变短了。
sentences.traditional: 白色的東西一點一點地出來了，他的鼻子一點一點地變短了。
sentences.pinyin: bái sè de dōng xi yì diǎn yì diǎn de chū lái le tā de bí zi yì diǎn yì diǎn de biàn duǎn le
sentences.english: Something white came out bit by bit, and his nose got shorter bit by bit.

sentences.simplified: 不知道过了多长时间，他的鼻子真的变短了，变得和别人一样短了。
sentences.traditional: 不知道過了多長時間，他的鼻子真的變短了，變得和別人一樣短了。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào guò le duō cháng shí jiān tā de bí zi zhēn de biàn duǎn le biàn de hé bié ren yí yàng duǎn le
sentences.english: After who knows how long, his nose really did get shorter, and became as short as other people’s.

raw.synopsis: Teacher Zhang has an unusual nose.
sentence_translations: Zhang Han asked a few people to come and hit his nose for him.
He put his nose into hot water, and then had these people hit his nose.
He thought it would be very painful, but unexpectedly, when he put his nose in the hot water, it didn’t hurt.
When other people hit his nose, it also didn’t hurt.
After a while, he found that a white thing had fallen out of his nose and his nose had become a bit shorter.
He put his nose in the hot water again.
Then he got the people to hit his nose again, and let them hit it a few more times.
After a while, another white thing came out of his nose. His nose became shorter again.
Just like this, he put his nose in hot water, then had people hit his nose, and a bit more of something white came out.
He put his nose in hot water, then had people hit his nose …
Something white came out bit by bit, and his nose got shorter bit by bit.
After who knows how long, his nose really did get shorter, and became as short as other people’s.
